examples.arabic: الطريق كان زحمة جدا زي كل يوم
examples.english: The road was very crowded, like every day.
examples.transliteration: Et tareeq kan zahma geddan zayy koll yom

examples.arabic: عارفة ان الطريق هيبقى زحمة النهاردة عشان كده لازم انزل دلوقتي
examples.english: I know the road will be crowded today, that's why I must leave now.
examples.transliteration: Arfa ennet taree' hayeb'a zahma ennaharda ashan keda lazem anzil delwa'ti.

examples.arabic: كنت ماشي في القاهرة وزهقت من الطريق فتهت
examples.english: I was walking in Cairo and got tired of the road, so I got lost.
examples.transliteration: Kont mashi fi el Qahira we zehe't men el taree', fa tehet.
